# Northeastern Global News

> Northeastern Global News provides comprehensive coverage of university research, campus life, faculty expertise, and global topics with a focus on discovery and analysis.

This is the official news and communications hub for Northeastern University, featuring research discoveries, campus announcements, faculty expert directories, and media relations resources. The site serves students, faculty, staff, parents, and journalists seeking information about the university and its contributions to global knowledge.

## Key Topics

- Northeastern University
- Research and Discovery
- Campus Life
- Faculty Experts
- Student Stories
- University News
- Commencement
- Campus Safety
- Media Relations
- Co-op Programs
- Global Programs
- Matthews Arena
- Communications Team
- Alumni Spotlight
- Technology Trends

## Research & Discovery

- [NGN Research by Northeastern University](https://news.northeastern.edu/research): Portal showcasing Northeastern faculty research in science and discovery
- [Northeastern Researchers Propose New Way to Make Biofuel](https://news.northeastern.edu/2026/02/17/microbes-biofuels-woolston-lab): Research from Woolston Lab on efficient microbe-based biofuel production
- [Intrinsic Motivation at Work May Cost You, Research Reveals](https://news.northeastern.edu/2026/03/18/intrinsic-motivation-at-work-burnout-research): Sangah Bae's research on intrinsic motivation and workplace burnout dynamics

## Campus News & Community

- [Northeastern Global News - News, Discovery, and Analysis from Around the World](https://news.northeastern.edu): Homepage for Northeastern's news portal covering university news and global topics

- [When will Matthews Arena deconstruction be finished?](https://news.northeastern.edu/2026/03/02/matthews-arena-deconstruction-timeline): Campus news on Matthews Arena demolition timeline and reconstruction plans
